roleTitle: Staff Development Coordinator & Infection Control Nurse (RN)
description:

This vital role combines the critical functions of staff education and infection prevention, ensuring the highest standards of care and a safe environment for both residents and staff.

As the SDC/Infection Control Nurse, you will be instrumental in developing and implementing comprehensive training programs for our clinical team, alongside leading our infection control initiatives. Your expertise will directly contribute to the quality of care provided and the overall well-being of our community. This full-time position offers a competitive hourly rate of $40-$42.

If you are a proactive RN with a passion for education and patient safety, and you thrive in a dynamic healthcare setting, we encourage you to apply. Join a team committed to excellence and continuous improvement.
requirements: Active Registered Nurse (RN) license in Maryland
Proven experience in staff development and education within a healthcare setting
Demonstrated experience in infection prevention and control practices
Strong understanding of state and federal healthcare regulations
Excellent communication, organizational, and leadership skills
salaryOrBonusInfo: Hourly rate of $40-$42 based on experience.

description:

description:
Join a dynamic and growing home health agency dedicated to providing exceptional care to patients in the Billings, MT area. We are seeking a compassionate and skilled Registered Nurse to deliver high-quality, patient-centered care in the comfort of their homes. This role offers the flexibility of both full-time and part-time opportunities, allowing you to balance your professional and personal life while making a significant impact on patient well-being.

As a travel home health RN, you will manage a diverse caseload, performing comprehensive assessments, developing individualized care plans, and providing direct nursing care. You will collaborate with an interdisciplinary team to ensure seamless coordination of services and optimal patient outcomes. This is an excellent opportunity for an experienced RN looking for autonomy, variety, and a chance to truly connect with patients in their own environment.

We offer a competitive annual salary range of $115,000 - $125,000, reflecting your expertise and dedication. If you are passionate about home health and eager to join a supportive team, we encourage you to apply.
requirements: Current Registered Nurse (RN) license in Montana or a compact state
Minimum of 1-2 years of recent experience in home health, acute care, or a related setting
Valid driver's license and reliable transportation for travel to patient homes
Strong clinical assessment, documentation, and communication skills
Basic Life Support (BLS) certification
salaryOrBonusInfo: Annual salary range of $115,000 - $125,000, based on experience and contract type.

description:

This role is ideal for a physician seeking a non-traveling position with a strong emphasis on patient care within a specific legal and medical framework.

We are seeking a physician with a robust background in workers' compensation, prepared to manage a caseload without involvement in major medical insurance, Medicare, or Medicaid. Candidates must be available to work weekends to meet patient needs and facility schedules. This is a chance to make a substantial impact in a specialized field, offering both professional challenge and rewarding compensation.

Current and unrestricted New York State medical license

Minimum of 2 years of experience with Workers' Compensation or No-Fault/Lien cases
Ability to work weekends as needed
salaryOrBonusInfo: Compensation starts at $300,000+ per year, with a structure heavily weighted towards bonuses.
